name: Local repeated failing commands preserve argv identity, distinct execution IDs and measured exit timing
Dirty tracked and untracked content changes source identity without changing the Git index; committing identical content preserves identity
Reattachments, duplicate observations and legacy rows do not inflate execution counts; time bounds and invalid inputs behave correctly
Queued cancellation starts no command and reports no execution or unknown
Real SSH command failure records verified remote identity and command-only timing
TCP outage remains unknown until reconciliation; two verified executions count twice
Host cancellation during real npm preparation is immediately not-started
Reconciled host cancellation during real npm preparation removes unknown without counting an execution
A real no-mistakes help invocation is classified as pipeline-drive and excluded from execution counts
